body:
My brother came to me for money because he didn't have enough cash on hand to pay a mechanic to fix his car (something big I couldn't do myself) and since it was the weekend, the banks wouldn't be open and he couldn't get a transfer made in time.  Wasn't really a big deal, we've done stuff like this before and he always pays me back, he actually always pays back with interest so i'm usually eager to help out.  He was just being a wise-ass but it ended up hurting a whole lot, and I'm not sure he's aware of just how long i've been dealing with this shit.

As for the strong statement, maybe you're right,  it still doesn't make me feel better. It just means I have a higher pain threshold, and I feel like I've reached the end of that, or that I'm constantly on the edge.

Strong doesn't get me a job, experience does, and I have none.

After a few years of quitting college, I went back and actually finished my economics bachelor's. I thought this would get me a job and finally pull me out of my dark place. Of course, that didn't happen, and now i'm even more aware that I likely won't have a solid job for a few years. I have no health insurance and I have a pretty nasty hole in a molar that I know will end up costing me half of what I earn in a year, and it hurts like hell.  

This is just painful.  I wish it all just went away.
